newsitem.title: USA: Domtar could eye Avenor or Repap - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Domtar could eye Avenor or Repap - WSJ.

text.p: Domtar Inc could seek to acquire all or parts of Avenor Inc or Repap Enterprises Inc, which are trying to combine, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Monday.
Avenor cut its all-stock offer for financially-troubled Repap to C$2.75 billion from C$3.4 billion on March 3. Both are Montreal-based pulp and paper companies.
The paper said some people in the industry believed Montreal paper maker Domtar could step into the fray.

Kevin Dougherty, a spokesman for the Caisse de depot et placement du Quebec, was quoted in the paper as saying: "In the face of the probable failure of the proposed merger (of Avenor and Repap) we can presume that certain companies may have started analyzing projects for acquisition of shares or assets, and that this has given rise to many rumors, (on) which we don't comment."
Caisse de depot manages public pension funds for the Quebec provincial government.
